mentions.name: Sendery
mentions.description: This platform is a transactional email service for product teams. It addresses the pain of managing product emails at scale by helping teams track hundreds of templates, keep designs consistent, coordinate changes between developers and marketing/ops, and manage emails across multiple languages.
mentions.problem: Managing product emails as companies scale is time-consuming: tracking hundreds of templates, maintaining consistent designs, coordinating changes between developers and marketing/ops, and supporting multiple languages.
mentions.audience: Product teams, including developers and marketing/ops staff managing product emails.
mentions.source_excerpt: A small team and I are working on Sendery [1], a transactional email platform for product teams.

evidence.value: A small team and I are working on Sendery [1], a transactional email platform for product teams.
